ops.old: Soft yeasted flatbreads blistered in a smoking pan, brushed with garlic, parsley and thyme butter, with a bowl of whipped feta and honey. Mix 400g plain flour, 7g dried yeast, 1 tsp sugar, 1 tsp salt, 250ml warm water and 2 tbsp olive oil and knead 8 minutes, then prove 1 hour. Divide into 8, roll thin and cook in a smoking dry pan for 1 to 2 minutes a side until blistered. Melt 60g butter with 2 crushed garlic cloves, parsley and thyme and brush over. Blend 200g feta with 100g Greek yoghurt, then drizzle with honey.
